            memo[i, j] = memo[i - 1, j]

            if weight <= j:  # Fix: change '<' to '<='
                memo[i, j] = max(
                    memo[i, j],
                    value + memo[i - 1, j - weight]
                )

    return memo[len(items), capacity]
